# Mutation testing job for .github/workflows/ci.yml.
#
# Merge this job into the existing `jobs:` mapping; do not create a second
# workflow for it. Mutation testing runs on one PHP version because it is
# expensive and the mutation score does not depend on the runtime. Pick the
# newest compatible PHP runtime selected for the target's mutation toolchain.
# Replace every REPLACE_WITH sentinel and add a versioned-lock `cp` step only
# when the target actually maintains one for that runtime.
#
# The commands live here rather than in Composer scripts. This gate runs in CI,
# so a Composer wrapper would only add a layer to look through, a second place
# for the flags to drift, and a 300-second process timeout to work around.
#
# Pull requests are scored on their changed lines against the stricter
# thresholds passed below; the default branch is scored on the whole source tree
# against the thresholds in infection.json5.
  mutation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Scoring a pull request means diffing it against its base branch,
          # which needs more than the single commit a shallow clone provides.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: 'REPLACE_WITH_MUTATION_JOB_PHP'
          extensions: REPLACE_WITH_REQUIRED_EXTENSIONS
          # Infection needs a coverage driver. pcov is several times faster than
          # Xdebug and Infection collects nothing Xdebug alone can provide.
          coverage: pcov

      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      # Infection's own initial test run cannot be used against a strict toolkit
      # PHPUnit configuration; see the skill for why. Drop --do-not-fail-on-risky
      # if the project's suite is green with coverage enabled.
      - name: Generate coverage for mutation testing
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/phpunit
          --no-extensions
          --do-not-fail-on-risky
          --coverage-xml build/infection-coverage/coverage-xml
          --log-junit build/infection-coverage/junit.xml

      # Size memory_limit for the reports rather than for the run: Infection holds
      # every mutant result and encodes all of them into build/infection.json once
      # the score is printed, so a large source tree exhausts a limit the scoring
      # itself never came close to — and it does so after the score, failing the
      # job on a report. Raise this when the tree grows.
      - name: Mutation testing on changed lines
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G vendor/bin/infection
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=max
          --coverage=build/infection-coverage
          --skip-initial-tests
          --git-diff-lines
          --git-diff-base="origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF}"
          --ignore-msi-with-no-mutations

root. Resolve every path from the target's selected source directories.

Exclude a directory only when its tests cannot run in the same job as the gate — for
example code exercised exclusively by a legacy PHPUnit configuration on an older PHP
version. Write the reason in the file. Do not exclude code because its mutants
survive.

## Timeouts

`timeout` is an operational starting point, not a quality threshold. Measure the
slowest relevant mutant test and set it above that duration with enough runner
headroom; do not keep `10` merely because the first run was green. A timeout must
not count as a killed mutant:

- Infection 0.32.3 and later must set `timeoutsAsEscaped: true` and
  `maxTimeouts: 0`.
- Older supported Infection lines cannot express that policy. Prefer running the
  isolated mutation job on a current Infection line. If the target is genuinely
  pinned older, report the limitation and choose a timeout above the measured test
  duration; do not pretend timeout classification is enforced.

## Coverage Collection

Let Infection run its normal initial test phase and generate the coverage it needs.
With pcov or Xdebug enabled, no separate PHPUnit coverage command is required.
`--coverage` means reuse an existing XML and JUnit report; it is not a prerequisite
for mutation testing. `--skip-initial-tests` is only valid when that existing report
is supplied and the suite was already proved green.

Do not add a `Generate coverage for mutation testing` step solely for Infection,
and do not pass `--coverage` or `--skip-initial-tests` in the standard job. Reuse a
pre-generated report only when the workflow already creates it for another
independent consumer and the saved runtime justifies the extra coupling.

Keep `"testFrameworkExtraArgs": "--no-extensions"` so the toolkit's AI reporter
cannot replace the PHPUnit result output Infection reads to distinguish killed from
escaped mutants. A risky or failing initial test should fail the mutation job; do
not weaken PHPUnit with `--do-not-fail-on-risky`.

`testFrameworkExtraArgs` arrived in Infection 0.34. On an older line the same value
goes under `testFrameworkOptions`, which every version from 0.26 accepts and 0.34
and later still honour; setting both is an error.

## Do Not Wrap It in Composer Scripts

Write the commands into the workflow. This gate runs in CI, so a Composer script
would add a layer to look through, a second place for the flags to drift from the
job that actually runs them, and Composer's 300-second process timeout to work
around — a mutation run on a suite of any size takes longer than that, and the
script dies partway through with a process timeout instead of a score.

Composer scripts earn their place when a command is run by hand on every save, like
`composer lint`. Mutation testing is not that command, and it does not belong inside
`composer lint` either: those gates are seconds, this one is minutes.

Do not explain this tooling in the target project's product `docs/` or rewrite its
README or `AGENTS.md`. The workflow and this vendor skill are the development
documentation unless the user explicitly names another developer-owned location.

## CI Wiring

Merge `mutation-job.yml` into `.github/workflows/ci.yml` as a separate job. It needs
three things the other jobs do not:

- `fetch-depth: 0` on checkout, so the pull request can be diffed against its base.
- A coverage driver: `coverage: pcov` in `setup-php`.
- A branch on the event: a changed-lines step guarded by
  `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`, a whole-tree step guarded by the
  negation.

Use the highest PHP version in the target's supported matrix for this one-off job,
not the template's literal version. Derive its extensions from Composer platform
requirements and the commands in the job, require the selected lock file to exist,
and run `composer check-platform-reqs` after installation. Treat job timeout,
memory limits, and `--threads` as measured operational values: size them from the
observed run and runner capacity without altering mutation scope or thresholds.

Take the base branch from `origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF}` rather than hardcoding the
default branch. GitHub sets that variable on pull request events, so a pull request
against a release branch is scored against that branch. Read it as a shell
environment variable rather than through `${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}`
interpolation: a branch name pasted into the shell as literal text is a script
injection waiting to happen.

## Protecting the Configuration

Mutation thresholds are the first thing an agent lowers when a build goes red, so
treat these files the way the project treats its other non-negotiable configuration:

- Recommend protecting `infection.json5` in the agent permission system. Do not
  edit `.claude/settings.json`, `AGENTS.md`, or another agent-owned policy file
  unless the user explicitly asks for that change.
- Add the file to `.gitattributes` with `export-ignore` if the project excludes dev
  configuration from its distributed archive.
- Keep `ForbiddenCommentRule` enabled. It rejects `@infection-ignore-all`, which is
  the other way to make a mutant disappear without writing a test.

## Verification

Run the two local commands above, or push the branch and read the job. Exit codes:

`@coversNothing` tags. Run both configuration files to find missing metadata.

Set `includeUncoveredFiles="true"` and `disableCodeCoverageIgnore="true"` on
`<coverage>` for every major. The first prevents untouched source files from
disappearing from coverage reports; the second prevents ignore metadata from
silently inflating coverage.

## Recommended Composer Scripts

Add to the target project's `composer.json`:

```json
{
    "scripts": {
        "test": "phpunit",
        "test:unit": "phpunit --testsuite unit"
    }
}
```

For a real multi-major matrix, copy `phpunit.php` from this skill to the project
root along with one configuration per installed major. The runner reads the
installed `phpunit/phpunit` version and selects the matching schema, including the
separate PHPUnit 10, 11, and 12 files. This keeps the public Composer command stable
instead of making CI reimplement dependency resolution as a matrix-to-script map:

```json
{
    "scripts": {
        "test:unit": "@php -d memory_limit=512M phpunit.php"
    }
}
```

Run `composer test:unit` under every maintained dependency graph and confirm the
selected file validates. Do not point the generic script at the newest schema when
an older supported runtime installs PHPUnit 10–12.

## Parallel Execution with ParaTest

Offer [ParaTest](https://github.com/paratestphp/paratest) once the suite is long
enough that developers start narrowing it with `--filter` — but explain what it
buys beyond speed, because that is the reason to prefer it as the default `test`
script rather than an optional extra.

Each ParaTest worker is a separate PHP process, so the suite has to hold up
without a shared runtime: no test reading a static property another test set, no
two tests writing the same fixture path, no class assuming it runs after some
other class. `executionOrder="depends,random"` already looks for that coupling
inside one process; splitting the suite checks it across the process boundary,
which no PHPUnit setting reaches. This matters most for AI-written tests, where
shared temporary paths and static caches are a routine shortcut.

```bash
composer require --dev "brianium/paratest:<target-derived-constraint>" --dry-run
```

Select that constraint with the same target-first process as PHPUnit: use the
newest ParaTest release compatible with the resolved PHPUnit version and the PHP
runtime of the parallel job. Run the command without `--dry-run` after confirming
the resolution. Add an older ParaTest line only when a real supported graph needs
it; do not copy this repository's union.

```json
{
    "scripts": {
        "test": "@php -d memory_limit=512M phpunit.php --parallel --processes=auto",
        "test:unit": "@php -d memory_limit=512M phpunit.php"
    }
}
```

Three things to check before wiring it in:

- `ext-pcntl` must be available; it is what ParaTest forks workers with. Add it
  to the CI `extensions:` list.
- `phpunit.php` passes the selected configuration to ParaTest, so every supported
  dependency graph uses the schema for its installed PHPUnit major.
- Keep the single-process script for local debugging and tools that invoke PHPUnit
  directly. CI should use the parallel `composer test` command in its PHP matrix;
  duplicating the same suite in a second CI job adds no gate.

## Verification

After applying:

```bash
vendor/bin/phpunit --list-tests   # Verify tests are discovered
composer test:unit                 # Run the full suite in one process
composer test                      # Run it again through the parallel runner
```

If the suite passes in one process and fails under the parallel runner, the
failure is real: it is test-to-test coupling that the single-process run was
hiding. Fix the coupling rather than reverting to one process.

## References

- [PHPUnit AI Reporter](vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/docs/phpunit-ai-reporter.md) — Reporter behavior and output contract
existing toolkit pin and update its lock within that constraint.

Read `composer config vendor-dir` as well. Every include below is rooted at that
project-derived directory (`vendor` is only Composer's default).

`phpstan/phpstan-strict-rules` is a runtime dependency of the toolkit; do not add
a separately chosen version constraint to the target project.

The default setup loads the toolkit explicitly and does not need
`phpstan/extension-installer`. If that Composer plugin is present solely for the
toolkit or strict-rules, remove it and its `allow-plugins` entry. If another
PHPStan extension genuinely needs the plugin, keep it but add both
`k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit` and `phpstan/phpstan-strict-rules` to
`extra.phpstan/extension-installer.ignore`; the target configuration loads both
explicitly and PHPStan rejects a configuration file included twice.

## Target Configuration

Copy the shipped template to the configuration name the project already uses
(`phpstan.neon` or `phpstan.neon.dist`):

```neon
# NOTE: You do not have permission to overwrite this file. Please ask a human operator to perform the changes for you.

includes:
    - REPLACE_WITH_VENDOR_DIR/phpstan/phpstan-strict-rules/rules.neon
    - REPLACE_WITH_VENDOR_DIR/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/extension.neon
    - REPLACE_WITH_VENDOR_DIR/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/rules.neon

parameters:
    level: max
    paths:
        - REPLACE_WITH_ANALYSIS_PATH
```

Replace `REPLACE_WITH_VENDOR_DIR` with `composer config vendor-dir` before use. A
remaining sentinel is a configuration error, not a literal directory name. Replace
`REPLACE_WITH_ANALYSIS_PATH` with every production and test autoload root derived
from `composer.json`; repeat the list item for multiple roots.

Analysis scope belongs in PHPStan configuration so direct invocations, editor
integrations, Composer, and CI all analyse the same paths. Do not put the paths only
on the Composer command. Keep that command independent of project layout:

```json
{
    "scripts": {
        "phpstan": "phpstan analyse --memory-limit=512M",
        "lint": [
            "@format:check",
            "@phpstan"
        ]
    }
}
```

## Existing Configuration

Reduce an existing configuration to the three baseline includes, `level: max`, the
project's complete `paths`, and settings that are both project-specific and
necessary. Remove copied rule definitions, the old error-formatter include, and
copied exception defaults.

The following additions can be legitimate:

- `bootstrapFiles` for runtime symbols PHPStan cannot otherwise discover;
- narrow `excludePaths` for generated or deliberately invalid fixtures;
- PHP version bounds derived from the declared support range; and
- `parameters.toolkit` when the project uses non-standard namespace or path
  conventions.

name: setup-php-ai-toolkit
description: >-
  Set up php-ai-toolkit end to end in a PHP project by selecting and applying
  the relevant setup-toolkit component skills. Use for a complete toolkit setup;
  use the named component skill directly when the request concerns one tool only.
---

# Set Up php-ai-toolkit

This skill is the entry point for applying php-ai-toolkit to a user's project.
It coordinates the component setup skills; the component skills own the detailed
requirements, templates, and verification steps.

## Inspect the Project

Before selecting components, read:

- `composer.json`, including PHP constraints, autoload roots, dependencies, and
  scripts;
- the source and test directory layout;
- existing tool configuration and GitHub Actions workflows; and
- the project's current diff so unrelated changes are preserved.

Use values derived from the target project. Do not copy PHP versions, paths,
namespaces, dependency constraints, or CI settings from the php-ai-toolkit
repository.

## Apply Component Skills

Read and follow the component skills in this order:

1. `/setup-toolkit-phpstan`
2. `/setup-toolkit-phpunit` and `/setup-toolkit-doctest`
3. Assess performance-sensitive public operations and use
   `/setup-toolkit-phpbench` only when a stable representative workload can
   support a useful local benchmark or pull-request comparison
4. Assess the project's contracts and use `/setup-toolkit-pbt` and/or
   `/setup-toolkit-fuzzing` only where structured properties or coverage-guided
   exploration provide a meaningful oracle
5. `/setup-toolkit-php-cs-fixer` and `/setup-toolkit-php-compatibility`
6. `/setup-toolkit-loc-guard` and `/setup-toolkit-tree-guard`
7. `/setup-toolkit-deptrac`
8. `/setup-toolkit-infection`
9. `/setup-toolkit-docgen`
10. `/setup-toolkit-github-actions`

Use `/setup-toolkit-agents-md` only when the user explicitly asks to create or
change `AGENTS.md`.

When multiple component skills update the same target file, combine their
requirements into that file. GitHub Actions is applied last so its jobs invoke the
commands and configuration selected by the other component skills.

PHPBench, fuzzing, and PBT are not checkbox gates. Skip PHPBench when no stable
representative workload exists. Skip either fuzzing or PBT when no contract has a
generator and oracle strong enough to justify it, and report those decisions.

The core adoption is incomplete until PHPStan, PHPUnit, PHP-CS-Fixer,
PHPCompatibility, LocGuard, TreeGuard, Deptrac, Infection, and GitHub Actions are
installed, configured, wired into Composer, and exercised. Doctest and DocGen are
also part of a complete adoption when the project has maintained PHPDoc examples or
published API documentation.

Do not silently classify a core component as inapplicable. LocGuard and TreeGuard
apply to every project with maintained production PHP source. PHPCompatibility
applies whenever the project declares a PHP support range. Deptrac applies even to
a flat library: discover or create a meaningful responsibility boundary, and stop
for the project's architecture decision if one cannot be derived without guessing.
If a core component is genuinely blocked by the target's runtime or dependency
graph, report the exact blocker and leave the overall setup incomplete.

Before applying GitHub Actions, verify this completion table against files and
Composer scripts rather than against work already attempted:

| Component | Required evidence |
|-----------|-------------------|
| PHPStan | `phpstan.neon` or `.dist`, and `composer phpstan` |
| PHPUnit | version-correct configuration, and `composer test:unit` |
| PHP-CS-Fixer | `.php-cs-fixer.dist.php`, and `composer format:check` |
| PHPCompatibility | `phpcs.xml.dist`, and `composer compat` |
| LocGuard | `loc.yaml`, and `composer loc-guard` |
| TreeGuard | `tree.yaml`, and `composer tree-guard` |
| Deptrac | `deptrac.yaml`, and `composer deptrac` |
| Infection | `infection.json5`, and a mutation CI job |

Every configured fast gate must also appear in the aggregate `lint` script. Re-open
the generated workflow after GitHub Actions is applied and confirm that every row
is invoked. Missing evidence is a setup failure, not an optional follow-up.

slowest relevant mutant test and set it above that duration with enough runner

not count as a killed mutant:

Let Infection run its normal initial test phase and generate the coverage it needs.
With pcov or Xdebug enabled, no separate PHPUnit coverage command is required.
`--coverage` means reuse an existing XML and JUnit report; it is not a prerequisite
for mutation testing. `--skip-initial-tests` is only valid when that existing report
is supplied and the suite was already proved green.

Do not add a `Generate coverage for mutation testing` step solely for Infection,
and do not pass `--coverage` or `--skip-initial-tests` in the standard job. Reuse a
pre-generated report only when the workflow already creates it for another
independent consumer and the saved runtime justifies the extra coupling.

cannot replace the PHPUnit result output Infection reads to distinguish killed from
escaped mutants. A risky or failing initial test should fail the mutation job; do
not weaken PHPUnit with `--do-not-fail-on-risky`.

# Set Up php-ai-toolkit

This skill is the entry point for applying php-ai-toolkit to a user's project.
It coordinates the component setup skills; the component skills own the detailed
requirements, templates, and verification steps.

## Inspect the Project

Before selecting components, read:

- `composer.json`, including PHP constraints, autoload roots, dependencies, and
  scripts;
- the source and test directory layout;
- existing tool configuration and GitHub Actions workflows; and
- the project's current diff so unrelated changes are preserved.

Use values derived from the target project. Do not copy PHP versions, paths,
namespaces, dependency constraints, or CI settings from the php-ai-toolkit
repository.

## Apply Component Skills

Read and follow the component skills in this order:

1. `/setup-toolkit-phpstan`
2. `/setup-toolkit-phpunit` and `/setup-toolkit-doctest`
3. Assess performance-sensitive public operations and use
   `/setup-toolkit-phpbench` only when a stable representative workload can
   support a useful local benchmark or pull-request comparison
4. Assess the project's contracts and use `/setup-toolkit-pbt` and/or
   `/setup-toolkit-fuzzing` only where structured properties or coverage-guided
   exploration provide a meaningful oracle
5. `/setup-toolkit-php-cs-fixer` and `/setup-toolkit-php-compatibility`
6. `/setup-toolkit-loc-guard` and `/setup-toolkit-tree-guard`
7. `/setup-toolkit-deptrac`
8. `/setup-toolkit-infection`
9. `/setup-toolkit-docgen`
10. `/setup-toolkit-github-actions`

Use `/setup-toolkit-agents-md` only when the user explicitly asks to create or
change `AGENTS.md`.

When multiple component skills update the same target file, combine their
requirements into that file. GitHub Actions is applied last so its jobs invoke the
commands and configuration selected by the other component skills.

PHPBench, fuzzing, and PBT are not checkbox gates. Skip PHPBench when no stable
representative workload exists. Skip either fuzzing or PBT when no contract has a
generator and oracle strong enough to justify it, and report those decisions.

The core adoption is incomplete until PHPStan, PHPUnit, PHP-CS-Fixer,
PHPCompatibility, LocGuard, TreeGuard, Deptrac, Infection, and GitHub Actions are
installed, configured, wired into Composer, and exercised. Doctest and DocGen are
also part of a complete adoption when the project has maintained PHPDoc examples or
published API documentation.

Do not silently classify a core component as inapplicable. LocGuard and TreeGuard
apply to every project with maintained production PHP source. PHPCompatibility
applies whenever the project declares a PHP support range. Deptrac applies even to
a flat library: discover or create a meaningful responsibility boundary, and stop
for the project's architecture decision if one cannot be derived without guessing.
If a core component is genuinely blocked by the target's runtime or dependency
graph, report the exact blocker and leave the overall setup incomplete.

Before applying GitHub Actions, verify this completion table against files and
Composer scripts rather than against work already attempted:

| Component | Required evidence |
|-----------|-------------------|
| PHPStan | `phpstan.neon` or `.dist`, and `composer phpstan` |
| PHPUnit | version-correct configuration, and `composer test:unit` |
| PHP-CS-Fixer | `.php-cs-fixer.dist.php`, and `composer format:check` |
| PHPCompatibility | `phpcs.xml.dist`, and `composer compat` |
| LocGuard | `loc.yaml`, and `composer loc-guard` |
| TreeGuard | `tree.yaml`, and `composer tree-guard` |
| Deptrac | `deptrac.yaml`, and `composer deptrac` |
| Infection | `infection.json5`, and a mutation CI job |

Every configured fast gate must also appear in the aggregate `lint` script. Re-open
the generated workflow after GitHub Actions is applied and confirm that every row
is invoked. Missing evidence is a setup failure, not an optional follow-up.

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - REPLACE_WITH_DEFAULT_BRANCH
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

jobs:
  tests:
    name: Tests on PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php:
          - 'REPLACE_WITH_SUPPORTED_PHP'
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: REPLACE_WITH_REQUIRED_EXTENSIONS
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          dependency-versions: REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      - name: Run the tests
        run: REPLACE_WITH_TEST_COMMAND

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: 'REPLACE_WITH_TOOLING_PHP'
          extensions: REPLACE_WITH_REQUIRED_EXTENSIONS
          coverage: none

      - name: Validate the Composer manifest against the lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          dependency-versions: REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      - name: Check the formatting
        run: composer format:check

      - name: Analyse with PHPStan
        run: composer phpstan

      - name: Check PHP compatibility
        run: composer compat

      - name: Check the source metrics
        run: composer loc-guard

      - name: Check the directory structure
        run: composer tree-guard

      - name: Check the architecture layers
        run: composer deptrac

item.stdout:
# Separate pull-request workflow for paired PHPBench measurements.
#
# Replace every REPLACE_WITH sentinel. Benchmark the merge-target SHA and the
# synthetic merge commit sequentially in this one job; do not split them across
# runners. Add disposable service setup before the measurements only when the
# benchmark contract explicitly includes that service.
name: Benchmarks

on:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  BENCH_PROJECT_DIR: 'REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY'
  BENCHMARK_PATH: 'REPLACE_WITH_BENCHMARK_PATH'
  PHPBENCH_CONFIG: 'REPLACE_WITH_PHPBENCH_CONFIG'
  PERFORMANCE_GATE: 'REPLACE_WITH_TRUE_OR_FALSE'
  MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT: '10'

jobs:
  compare:
    name: Compare with merge target
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out the candidate merge commit
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: candidate
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check out the merge target
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          path: baseline
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: 'REPLACE_WITH_BENCH_PHP'
          extensions: REPLACE_WITH_REQUIRED_EXTENSIONS
          coverage: none

      - name: Validate benchmark workflow settings
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          case "$PERFORMANCE_GATE" in
            true|false) ;;
            *)
              echo 'PERFORMANCE_GATE must be true or false.' >&2
              exit 2
              ;;
          esac

          case "$MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*)
              echo 'MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT must be a non-negative integer.' >&2
              exit 2
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Determine whether the revisions are comparable
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          baseline_project="baseline/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR"
          candidate_project="candidate/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR"
          comparison_kind='comparable'
          comparison_reason='Benchmark harness and configuration are unchanged.'

          if [ ! -f "$candidate_project/$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" ]; then
            echo "Candidate PHPBench configuration is missing: $candidate_project/$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" >&2
            echo 'Install the shared PHPBench configuration before enabling this workflow.' >&2
            exit 2
          elif [ ! -d "$candidate_project/$BENCHMARK_PATH" ]; then
            echo "Candidate benchmark directory is missing: $candidate_project/$BENCHMARK_PATH" >&2
            echo 'Create at least one benchmark subject before enabling this workflow.' >&2
            exit 2
          elif ! php -r '$composer = json_decode((string) file_get_contents($argv[1]), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR); exit(isset($composer["require-dev"]["phpbench/phpbench"]) ? 0 : 1);' "$candidate_project/composer.json"; then
            echo 'Candidate require-dev does not contain phpbench/phpbench.' >&2
            echo 'Install PHPBench as a direct development dependency.' >&2
            exit 2
          elif [ ! -f "$baseline_project/$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" ] || [ ! -d "$baseline_project/$BENCHMARK_PATH" ]; then
            comparison_kind='initial'
            comparison_reason='The merge target has no benchmark suite yet; this run records the candidate only.'
          elif ! php -r '$composer = json_decode((string) file_get_contents($argv[1]), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR); exit(isset($composer["require-dev"]["phpbench/phpbench"]) ? 0 : 1);' "$baseline_project/composer.json"; then
            comparison_kind='initial'
            comparison_reason='The merge target does not install PHPBench yet; this run records the candidate only.'
          elif ! diff -q "$baseline_project/$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" "$candidate_project/$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" >/dev/null; then
            comparison_kind='harness-changed'
            comparison_reason='The PHPBench configuration changed, so the measurements cannot form a gate.'
          elif ! diff -qr "$baseline_project/$BENCHMARK_PATH" "$candidate_project/$BENCHMARK_PATH" >/dev/null; then
            comparison_kind='harness-changed'
            comparison_reason='Benchmark code or benchmark-owned fixtures changed, so the measurements cannot form a gate.'
          fi

          echo "BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND=$comparison_kind" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "BENCH_COMPARISON_REASON=$comparison_reason" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Install candidate dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          working-directory: candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
          dependency-versions: REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT

      - name: Check candidate platform requirements
        working-directory: candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      - name: Install merge-target dependencies
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          working-directory: baseline/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
          dependency-versions: REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT

      - name: Check merge-target platform requirements
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        working-directory: baseline/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      - name: Verify the PHPBench tool version is comparable
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          baseline_phpbench="baseline/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/bin/phpbench"
          candidate_phpbench="candidate/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/bin/phpbench"
          baseline_version=$("$baseline_phpbench" --version)
          candidate_version=$("$candidate_phpbench" --version)

          if [ "$baseline_version" != "$candidate_version" ]; then
            echo 'REDACTED' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo 'BENCH_COMPARISON_REASON=The PHPBench version changed, so the measurements cannot form a gate.' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi

      - name: Measure the merge-target baseline
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        working-directory: baseline/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p build/phpbench
          vendor/bin/phpbench run \
            --config="$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" \
            --tag=baseline \
            --dump-file=build/phpbench/baseline.xml \
            --progress=none \
            2>&1 | tee build/phpbench/baseline.txt

      - name: Transfer the baseline to the candidate
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          baseline_results="baseline/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR/build/phpbench"
          candidate_results="candidate/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR/build/phpbench"
          mkdir -p "$candidate_results/storage"
          cp -R "$baseline_results/storage/." "$candidate_results/storage/"
          cp "$baseline_results/baseline.xml" "$candidate_results/baseline.xml"

      - name: Compare the candidate with the merge target
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        working-directory: candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          assertion="mode(variant.time.avg) <= mode(baseline.time.avg) +/- ${MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT}%"
          arguments=(
            run
            "--config=$PHPBENCH_CONFIG"
            --tag=candidate
            --ref=baseline
            --report=aggregate
            --dump-file=build/phpbench/candidate.xml
            --progress=none
          )
          if [ "$PERFORMANCE_GATE" = 'true' ]; then
            arguments+=("--assert=$assertion")
          fi

          vendor/bin/phpbench "${arguments[@]}" 2>&1 | tee build/phpbench/comparison.txt

      - name: Measure a non-comparable candidate
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND != 'comparable'
        working-directory: candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p build/phpbench
          vendor/bin/phpbench run \
            --config="$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" \
            --tag=candidate \
            --report=aggregate \
            --dump-file=build/phpbench/candidate.xml \
            --progress=none \
            2>&1 | tee build/phpbench/candidate-only.txt

      - name: Record benchmark metadata
        if: always()
        working-directory: candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        shell: bash
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p build/phpbench
          {
            echo "base_sha=$BASE_SHA"
            echo "candidate_merge_sha=$CANDIDATE_SHA"
            echo "pull_request_head_sha=$HEAD_SHA"
            echo "comparison_kind=${BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND:-unknown}"
            echo "comparison_reason=${BENCH_COMPARISON_REASON:-unknown}"
            echo "performance_gate=$PERFORMANCE_GATE"
            echo "max_regression_percent=$MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT"
            uname -a
            php -v
            if [ -x vendor/bin/phpbench ]; then
              vendor/bin/phpbench --version
            fi
          } > build/phpbench/metadata.txt

      - name: Publish the benchmark job summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          results="candidate/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR/build/phpbench"
          report="$results/comparison.txt"
          if [ ! -f "$report" ]; then
            report="$results/candidate-only.txt"
          fi

          {
            echo '## PHPBench comparison'
            echo
            echo "- Merge target: \`$BASE_SHA\`"
            echo "- Candidate merge: \`$CANDIDATE_SHA\`"
            echo "- Comparison: ${BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND:-unknown}"
            echo "- Gate enabled: \`$PERFORMANCE_GATE\` (maximum regression ${MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT}%)"
            echo
            echo "${BENCH_COMPARISON_REASON:-Benchmark comparison did not start.}"
            if [ -f "$report" ]; then
              echo
              echo '```text'
              sed -n '1,240p' "$report"
              echo '```'
            fi
            echo
            echo 'Raw XML, full console output, storage, and environment metadata are attached to this run.'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Upload benchmark evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: phpbench-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            baseline/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY/build/phpbench
            candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY/build/phpbench
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Reject a non-comparable gated change
        if: >-
          always() &&
          env.PERFORMANCE_GATE == 'true' &&
          env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND != 'comparable' &&
          env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND != 'initial'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "A required performance gate is non-comparable: $BENCH_COMPARISON_REASON" >&2
          echo 'Review this as a benchmark calibration change before re-enabling the gate.' >&2
          exit 1
# Separate property-based test workflow.
#
# Replace every REPLACE_WITH sentinel. Add a versioned-lock `cp` step before
# installation only when the target project maintains one for REPLACE_WITH_PBT_JOB_PHP.
name: Property-based tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - REPLACE_WITH_DEFAULT_BRANCH
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      seed:
        description: Optional ERIS_SEED from a failing run; leave empty to explore
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

jobs:
  pbt:
    name: Eris properties
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: REPLACE_WITH_PBT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: 'REPLACE_WITH_PBT_JOB_PHP'
          extensions: REPLACE_WITH_REQUIRED_EXTENSIONS
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          working-directory: REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
          dependency-versions: REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      - name: Run the property-based tests
        env:
          ERIS_SEED: ${{ inputs.seed || '' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          case "$ERIS_SEED" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*)
              if [ -n "$ERIS_SEED" ]; then
                echo 'seed must be empty or a non-negative integer.' >&2
                exit 2
              fi
              ;;
          esac

          composer test:pbt
# Separate scheduled workflow for contract-driven fuzzing.
#
# Replace every REPLACE_WITH sentinel. Repeat the matrix entry for each contract;
# do not combine targets that need different generators, corpora, services, or
# oracles. Add a versioned-lock `cp` step before installation only when the target
# project maintains one for REPLACE_WITH_FUZZ_JOB_PHP.
name: Fuzz

on:
  schedule:
    # Pick a deliberate cadence and a minute away from the start of the hour.
    - cron: 'REPLACE_WITH_FUZZ_CRON'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      max_runs:
        description: Maximum inputs evaluated by each fuzz target
        required: true
        default: '10000'
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

jobs:
  fuzz:
    name: Fuzz ${{ matrix.target.name }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: REPLACE_WITH_FUZZ_TIMEOUT_MINUTES
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target:
          - name: REPLACE_WITH_CONTRACT_NAME
            script: fuzz/REPLACE_WITH_TARGET.php
            corpus: fuzz/corpus/REPLACE_WITH_CORPUS
            extensions: REPLACE_WITH_REQUIRED_EXTENSIONS
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: 'REPLACE_WITH_FUZZ_JOB_PHP'
          extensions: ${{ matrix.target.extensions }}
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          working-directory: REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
          dependency-versions: REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      - name: Restore the evolved corpus
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY/${{ matrix.target.corpus }}
          key: fuzz-${{ matrix.target.name }}-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_HASH_FILES') }}-${{ hashFiles('REPLACE_WITH_FUZZ_INPUT_HASH_FILES') }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: |
            fuzz-${{ matrix.target.name }}-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_HASH_FILES') }}-${{ hashFiles('REPLACE_WITH_FUZZ_INPUT_HASH_FILES') }}-
            fuzz-${{ matrix.target.name }}-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_HASH_FILES') }}-
            fuzz-${{ matrix.target.name }}-${{ runner.os }}-

      # Add disposable service/container startup here when the oracle compares
      # against a real database, HTTP server, or protocol implementation.
      - name: Run the fuzz target
        env:
          FUZZ_MAX_RUNS: ${{ inputs.max_runs || '10000' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          case "$FUZZ_MAX_RUNS" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*)
              echo 'max_runs must be a positive integer.' >&2
              exit 2
              ;;
          esac
          if [ "$FUZZ_MAX_RUNS" -lt 1 ]; then
            echo 'max_runs must be a positive integer.' >&2
            exit 2
          fi

          mkdir -p "${{ matrix.target.corpus }}"
          vendor/bin/php-fuzzer fuzz \
            "${{ matrix.target.script }}" \
            "${{ matrix.target.corpus }}/" \
            "--max-runs=$FUZZ_MAX_RUNS"

      - name: Save the evolved corpus
        if: always()
        uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY/${{ matrix.target.corpus }}
          key: fuzz-${{ matrix.target.name }}-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_HASH_FILES') }}-${{ hashFiles('REPLACE_WITH_FUZZ_INPUT_HASH_FILES') }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}

      - name: Upload crash inputs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: fuzz-crashes-${{ matrix.target.name }}
          path: REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY/crash-*
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: REPLACE_WITH_CRASH_RETENTION_DAYS
# Publishes the DocGen site of the default branch to GitHub Pages.
#
# One-time setup in the repository:
#   1. Create the empty documentation branch:
#        git switch --orphan gh-pages
#        git commit --allow-empty -m 'docs: create the documentation branch'
#        git push -u origin gh-pages
#        git switch REPLACE_WITH_DEFAULT_BRANCH
#   2. Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source: "Deploy from a branch",
#      branch "gh-pages", folder "/ (root)".
#
# The site owns the root of that branch: everything else there is replaced on
# every run, except `pr/` (previews written by docs-preview.yml) and `CNAME`
# (a custom Pages domain).
# Replace every REPLACE_WITH sentinel from the target project's support matrix,
# lock policy, extensions, and branch choices before installing this workflow.
name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - REPLACE_WITH_DEFAULT_BRANCH
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: REPLACE_WITH_DOCS_BRANCH

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: 'REPLACE_WITH_DOCGEN_JOB_PHP'
          extensions: REPLACE_WITH_REQUIRED_EXTENSIONS
          # pcov, not none, when the site should link every method to the test
          # cases covering it — that needs a --coverage-xml report, and pcov is
          # several times faster than Xdebug at producing one. Leave this at
          # `none` and drop the coverage step below when it should not.
          coverage: pcov

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/docgen-cache
          key: docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('REPLACE_WITH_SELECTED_LOCK_FILE') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('REPLACE_WITH_SELECTED_LOCK_FILE') }}-
            docgen-${{ runner.os }}-

      # The report --coverage points at below. A strict PHPUnit configuration
      # reports a test that executes an undeclared class as risky, so this step
      # is also what keeps the project's #[CoversClass] and #[UsesClass]
      # metadata honest. Drop it, and the --coverage option, when the site
      # should not carry per-method test references.
      - name: Generate the coverage report the site reads
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-xml build/coverage-xml

      # docgen is configured by its options alone, so this command is the
      # whole documentation configuration. The address the site is published
      # at is what the workflow knows and the command cannot work out, so the
      # job passes it: every page then carries its canonical link and the tags
      # a shared link is rendered from.
      - name: Generate the documentation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          vendor/bin/docgen --coverage=build/coverage-xml \
            --base-url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}"

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the site
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # The site owns the root of the branch; the pull request previews
          # under pr/ and a custom Pages domain in CNAME are kept.
          rsync -a --checksum --delete --exclude '/.git/' --exclude '/pr/' --exclude '/CNAME' ../build/docs/ ./

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: generate from ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"
# Publishes a per-pull-request DocGen preview, generated in diff mode against
# the base branch, under `pr/<number>/` of the documentation branch, and links
# it from the pull request. Closing the pull request removes it again.
#
# Requires docs.yml (or an equivalent) to own the root of that branch: this
# workflow only ever writes below `pr/<number>/`.
#
# Pull requests from forks are skipped: they run with a read-only token, so
# they cannot write to the branch or comment. Publishing those needs the
# hardened `workflow_run` pattern — build on `pull_request` and upload an
# artifact, then publish it from a workflow that runs on the default branch.
# Never switch this workflow to `pull_request_target`; that would run
# untrusted code with a write token.
# Replace every REPLACE_WITH sentinel with the same target-project values used
# by the default-branch documentation workflow.
name: Docs Preview

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - closed

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: REPLACE_WITH_DOCS_BRANCH

jobs:
  preview:
    name: Generate and publish the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action != 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      # Diff mode checks the base revision out into a temporary worktree, so
      # the history of both revisions has to be present.
      - name: Check out the pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: 'REPLACE_WITH_DOCGEN_JOB_PHP'
          extensions: REPLACE_WITH_REQUIRED_EXTENSIONS
          coverage: pcov

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/docgen-cache
          key: docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('REPLACE_WITH_SELECTED_LOCK_FILE') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('REPLACE_WITH_SELECTED_LOCK_FILE') }}-
            docgen-${{ runner.os }}-

      # Keep the preview product-equivalent to the default-branch site. Adapt
      # this command and the main workflow to the same project coverage script.
      - name: Generate the coverage report the preview reads
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-xml build/coverage-xml

      # The checkout is the merge of the pull request into its base, so
      # comparing it against the base commit is what the pull request changes.
      - name: Generate the documentation in diff mode
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          vendor/bin/docgen --coverage=build/coverage-xml --diff="${BASE_SHA}" \
            --base-url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}"

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the preview
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
          rsync -a --checksum --delete ../build/docs/ "pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
          # Jekyll is disabled for the whole site from its root, which the
          # preview may reach before the site itself has been published.
          touch .nojekyll

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this preview."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: preview pull request #${PR_NUMBER} at ${HEAD_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Comment the preview link on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Replace this with the site address when Pages serves a custom domain.
          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          preview_url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"

          gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --edit-last --create-if-none --body \
          "**Documentation preview:** ${preview_url}

          Generated in diff mode against \`${BASE_REF}\`, so every page marks what this pull
          request adds, removes, and changes; the display-mode switch next to the theme
          toggle shows the plain documentation, the marked documentation, or the changes
          alone.

          Updated for ${HEAD_SHA}. The preview is removed when this pull request is closed."

  cleanup:
    name: Remove the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action == 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}

      - name: Remove the preview
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          rm -rf "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch carries no preview of this pull request."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: remove the preview of pull request #${PR_NUMBER}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Note the removal on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --edit-last --body \
            'The documentation preview of this pull request has been removed.' \
            || echo 'This pull request has no preview comment.'
item.aggregated_output:
# Separate pull-request workflow for paired PHPBench measurements.
#
# Replace every REPLACE_WITH sentinel. Benchmark the merge-target SHA and the
# synthetic merge commit sequentially in this one job; do not split them across
# runners. Add disposable service setup before the measurements only when the
# benchmark contract explicitly includes that service.
name: Benchmarks

on:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  BENCH_PROJECT_DIR: 'REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY'
  BENCHMARK_PATH: 'REPLACE_WITH_BENCHMARK_PATH'
  PHPBENCH_CONFIG: 'REPLACE_WITH_PHPBENCH_CONFIG'
  PERFORMANCE_GATE: 'REPLACE_WITH_TRUE_OR_FALSE'
  MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT: '10'

jobs:
  compare:
    name: Compare with merge target
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out the candidate merge commit
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: candidate
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check out the merge target
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          path: baseline
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: 'REPLACE_WITH_BENCH_PHP'
          extensions: REPLACE_WITH_REQUIRED_EXTENSIONS
          coverage: none

      - name: Validate benchmark workflow settings
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          case "$PERFORMANCE_GATE" in
            true|false) ;;
            *)
              echo 'PERFORMANCE_GATE must be true or false.' >&2
              exit 2
              ;;
          esac

          case "$MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*)
              echo 'MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT must be a non-negative integer.' >&2
              exit 2
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Determine whether the revisions are comparable
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          baseline_project="baseline/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR"
          candidate_project="candidate/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR"
          comparison_kind='comparable'
          comparison_reason='Benchmark harness and configuration are unchanged.'

          if [ ! -f "$candidate_project/$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" ]; then
            echo "Candidate PHPBench configuration is missing: $candidate_project/$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" >&2
            echo 'Install the shared PHPBench configuration before enabling this workflow.' >&2
            exit 2
          elif [ ! -d "$candidate_project/$BENCHMARK_PATH" ]; then
            echo "Candidate benchmark directory is missing: $candidate_project/$BENCHMARK_PATH" >&2
            echo 'Create at least one benchmark subject before enabling this workflow.' >&2
            exit 2
          elif ! php -r '$composer = json_decode((string) file_get_contents($argv[1]), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR); exit(isset($composer["require-dev"]["phpbench/phpbench"]) ? 0 : 1);' "$candidate_project/composer.json"; then
            echo 'Candidate require-dev does not contain phpbench/phpbench.' >&2
            echo 'Install PHPBench as a direct development dependency.' >&2
            exit 2
          elif [ ! -f "$baseline_project/$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" ] || [ ! -d "$baseline_project/$BENCHMARK_PATH" ]; then
            comparison_kind='initial'
            comparison_reason='The merge target has no benchmark suite yet; this run records the candidate only.'
          elif ! php -r '$composer = json_decode((string) file_get_contents($argv[1]), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR); exit(isset($composer["require-dev"]["phpbench/phpbench"]) ? 0 : 1);' "$baseline_project/composer.json"; then
            comparison_kind='initial'
            comparison_reason='The merge target does not install PHPBench yet; this run records the candidate only.'
          elif ! diff -q "$baseline_project/$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" "$candidate_project/$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" >/dev/null; then
            comparison_kind='harness-changed'
            comparison_reason='The PHPBench configuration changed, so the measurements cannot form a gate.'
          elif ! diff -qr "$baseline_project/$BENCHMARK_PATH" "$candidate_project/$BENCHMARK_PATH" >/dev/null; then
            comparison_kind='harness-changed'
            comparison_reason='Benchmark code or benchmark-owned fixtures changed, so the measurements cannot form a gate.'
          fi

          echo "BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND=$comparison_kind" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "BENCH_COMPARISON_REASON=$comparison_reason" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Install candidate dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          working-directory: candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
          dependency-versions: REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT

      - name: Check candidate platform requirements
        working-directory: candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      - name: Install merge-target dependencies
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          working-directory: baseline/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
          dependency-versions: REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT

      - name: Check merge-target platform requirements
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        working-directory: baseline/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      - name: Verify the PHPBench tool version is comparable
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          baseline_phpbench="baseline/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/bin/phpbench"
          candidate_phpbench="candidate/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/bin/phpbench"
          baseline_version=$("$baseline_phpbench" --version)
          candidate_version=$("$candidate_phpbench" --version)

          if [ "$baseline_version" != "$candidate_version" ]; then
            echo 'REDACTED' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo 'BENCH_COMPARISON_REASON=The PHPBench version changed, so the measurements cannot form a gate.' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi

      - name: Measure the merge-target baseline
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        working-directory: baseline/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p build/phpbench
          vendor/bin/phpbench run \
            --config="$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" \
            --tag=baseline \
            --dump-file=build/phpbench/baseline.xml \
            --progress=none \
            2>&1 | tee build/phpbench/baseline.txt

      - name: Transfer the baseline to the candidate
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          baseline_results="baseline/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR/build/phpbench"
          candidate_results="candidate/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR/build/phpbench"
          mkdir -p "$candidate_results/storage"
          cp -R "$baseline_results/storage/." "$candidate_results/storage/"
          cp "$baseline_results/baseline.xml" "$candidate_results/baseline.xml"

      - name: Compare the candidate with the merge target
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND == 'comparable'
        working-directory: candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          assertion="mode(variant.time.avg) <= mode(baseline.time.avg) +/- ${MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT}%"
          arguments=(
            run
            "--config=$PHPBENCH_CONFIG"
            --tag=candidate
            --ref=baseline
            --report=aggregate
            --dump-file=build/phpbench/candidate.xml
            --progress=none
          )
          if [ "$PERFORMANCE_GATE" = 'true' ]; then
            arguments+=("--assert=$assertion")
          fi

          vendor/bin/phpbench "${arguments[@]}" 2>&1 | tee build/phpbench/comparison.txt

      - name: Measure a non-comparable candidate
        if: env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND != 'comparable'
        working-directory: candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p build/phpbench
          vendor/bin/phpbench run \
            --config="$PHPBENCH_CONFIG" \
            --tag=candidate \
            --report=aggregate \
            --dump-file=build/phpbench/candidate.xml \
            --progress=none \
            2>&1 | tee build/phpbench/candidate-only.txt

      - name: Record benchmark metadata
        if: always()
        working-directory: candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY
        shell: bash
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p build/phpbench
          {
            echo "base_sha=$BASE_SHA"
            echo "candidate_merge_sha=$CANDIDATE_SHA"
            echo "pull_request_head_sha=$HEAD_SHA"
            echo "comparison_kind=${BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND:-unknown}"
            echo "comparison_reason=${BENCH_COMPARISON_REASON:-unknown}"
            echo "performance_gate=$PERFORMANCE_GATE"
            echo "max_regression_percent=$MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT"
            uname -a
            php -v
            if [ -x vendor/bin/phpbench ]; then
              vendor/bin/phpbench --version
            fi
          } > build/phpbench/metadata.txt

      - name: Publish the benchmark job summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          results="candidate/$BENCH_PROJECT_DIR/build/phpbench"
          report="$results/comparison.txt"
          if [ ! -f "$report" ]; then
            report="$results/candidate-only.txt"
          fi

          {
            echo '## PHPBench comparison'
            echo
            echo "- Merge target: \`$BASE_SHA\`"
            echo "- Candidate merge: \`$CANDIDATE_SHA\`"
            echo "- Comparison: ${BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND:-unknown}"
            echo "- Gate enabled: \`$PERFORMANCE_GATE\` (maximum regression ${MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT}%)"
            echo
            echo "${BENCH_COMPARISON_REASON:-Benchmark comparison did not start.}"
            if [ -f "$report" ]; then
              echo
              echo '```text'
              sed -n '1,240p' "$report"
              echo '```'
            fi
            echo
            echo 'Raw XML, full console output, storage, and environment metadata are attached to this run.'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Upload benchmark evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: phpbench-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            baseline/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY/build/phpbench
            candidate/REPLACE_WITH_WORKING_DIRECTORY/build/phpbench
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Reject a non-comparable gated change
        if: >-
          always() &&
          env.PERFORMANCE_GATE == 'true' &&
          env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND != 'comparable' &&
          env.BENCH_COMPARISON_KIND != 'initial'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "A required performance gate is non-comparable: $BENCH_COMPARISON_REASON" >&2
          echo 'Review this as a benchmark calibration change before re-enabling the gate.' >&2
          exit 1
